neighbours.label: the discourse phrases 'so far, so good' and 'not so fast'
fire: The first lap went well. So far, so good.
We passed the first test. So far so good.
The engine started right away. So far, so good.
You think you've won? Not so fast.
The deal looks done, right? Not so fast.
Everyone was happy at first. So far, so good.
They think taxes will fall. Not so fast.
Our budget is on track. So far, so good.
quiet: The first lap went well. Then it rained.
We passed the first test. It was easy.
The engine started right away. We drove off.
You think you've won? Think again.
The deal looks done, right? It is.
Everyone was so happy at first. It was nice.
They think taxes will fall. They might.
Our budget is on track. We ran far.
